caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible bubbles, topped with crisp menma and shredded cabbage. A white ceramic bowl holds the meal, set on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and bubbly, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, with a slightly translucent, fibrous texture and irregular, segmented shape.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A white plastic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and rounded bowl shape.
